name: The Institutional Dealing Room
mission: Execution, order management, portfolio operations, trade lifecycle, exposure control, and post-trade discipline.
psychology: Silence, precision, restraint, accountability, execution quality.
architecture: A private dealing room with low-reflection instrument walls, execution desks, order rails, exposure wells, compliance glass, and settlement corridors.
signature: Nothing celebrates movement; the room rewards clean execution, controlled exposure, and complete records.
environmental_laws: Every visible surface must resolve to a registered material.
Every material must define optical, tactile, aging, and performance behavior.
Every interaction must communicate mass, resistance, transfer, or causality.
No component may float without architectural support or explicit suspension.
Every light effect must trace to a defined emitter.
Every sound must originate from an object, mechanism, or state.
No animation may exist solely as decoration.
Information must occupy measurable space and obey the environment's navigation model.
Framework-default controls, generic cards, and template dashboards are prohibited.
Raw visual values outside token files are prohibited.
The environment may not break character across desktop, tablet, or mobile.
Accessibility, legibility, and operator control override spectacle.
Reduced-motion and reduced-sensory modes are mandatory.
All deviations must be explicit and reviewable.
No market signal may bypass provenance, timestamp, confidence, and source state.
No trade state may skip risk, invalidation, or audit requirements.
Market interpretation must distinguish observation, inference, scenario, and action.
